reviews.comment: your TA is a make or break. sooo many assignments EVERY week. they also don't respect your time because they would constantly push back due dates because they were behind on grading and so all the works piled up until the end around finals season dr T himself was fine but again, just depends on your TA
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Similar to CHEM 231, your grade mostly depends on your TA, but both the TA and Dr. Thompson are very flexible with the grading. You have two attempts on every assignment, and your TA and Dr. Thompson will tell you what you need to fix for the v2s. Meeting three times (especially two labs a week) can be tiring, but it's a very easy class, overall.

Dr. Thompson is an amazing professor who genuinely cares about his students. The class is a 20 minute lecture followed by group work on a worksheet that you turn in the next day for extra credit. Yes, there is a lot of self learning to be done but these worksheets allow you to score well on exams. The class is hard but fair. Highly recommend him.

Dr. Thompson is great! His lectures are pretty short, and he's great at making complicated concepts seem really easy. The extra credit worksheets are super helpful for understanding the material. He cares a lot about his students, and takes the time to have extra office hours and practice exam reviews.

Dr Thompson is a good and really caring teacher. The class was a 20-ish minute lecture that reviews what you should've read before in the textbook. He does a great job summarizing and connecting concepts quickly, but it is difficult to understand if you didn't do the reading. Everything on the tests is on the worksheets provided during lecture.

This was a tough class and you cant expect the prof. to just teach everything during lecture and you wont have to review. You're gonna have to.

He is a good person, but his teaching style doesn't suit the class imo. He condenses the info in 20ish min, and gives you a ws based on it. Office hours = Q&A session, reviews exams 1-2 days prior to exam.

Get ready to read and memorize. Don't depend on Dr. Thompson to baby feed you just like how the other OChem teachers do. Will not give you any reaction cheat sheet and no reagent/solvent word bank during exams. Forgot to print out 2 pages of the first exam and didn't give us a curve. Good extra credit, saved me a whole bunch.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Thompson is very kind and cares about all his students. Lectures are insightful but difficult to understand if you do not read to textbook before class. There is a lot of textbook to read before class. Tests are very difficult with no cheat sheets or reactions given, you need to memorize everything. But there is ample extra credit.

He is a nice guy but not a good teacher. He writes his tests the night before the test. Lectures for 15 minutes then gives you 8+ page worksheets to complete for extra credit, however if you didn't understand his short lecture the worksheets are extremely difficult. Worksheets and books don't reflect the tests and won't make his own practice test.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Get ready to teach yourself the material. O-chem is already hard, and this class feels even tougher because he barely teaches. Lectures are only a few minutes instead of the “20 minutes” he says and notes come after class. Office hours barely helped and just showed how much extra work this class adds on top of my other courses.

15-20 minutes of lecture so get ready to teach yourself literally everything. The rest of class is dedicated to practice sheets that can span from 6-15 pages and are extra credit, but they're due at NOON the next day. Exams look nothing like the homework, textbook, mock exams, or practice problems so kinda confusing there. He's very nice and chill.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Do not take if you are ready to teach this entire course to yourself. His lectures was 15-20 minutes and the rest of the class time was just doing homework. He would confuse himself and provide wrong answers sometimes. He also provided no supplemental data for the final when other sections got an entire cheat sheet for the final.

If you have time to teach yourself ochem, then take Dr. Thompson. Great guy, but only lectured for 10-20 mins per class, gave out 7-15 page worksheets that are extra credit, but when you don't know what you are doing, they are impossible to complete. Lots of reading and online homework that is nothing like the exams. I would not recommend.

Dr. Thompson is a very sweet professor who is willing to work with students, but I will say that his lectures do not prepare students at all for exams. If you're able to teach yourself outside of class, take his course but if not, do not take. His exams do not reflect the worksheets or homework's. It is his first semester though so maybe that's why
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Yapped for like 10 minutes and then gave us a worksheet each day. The worksheets, homework, and textbook will NOT prepare you for the test, the only similar thing are the 2 mock exams. The TA's and SI sessions were helpful though. Unless you really trust yourself to spend time learning everything alone with outside resources you're cooked.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Thompson is awesome! Part of class is lecture, and the other part is working on worksheets for practice on new and past material. Worksheets can also be turned in for extra credit. He is super accessible outside of class, and very helpful in office hours. Lastly, he's a really funny, genuine guy, and he really cares about students' learning.

Dr. Thompson does a great job of making Ochem seem less like a burden and more like a puzzle, lectures are dense and (imo) are great for people who struggle to focus because they rarely exceed 25 minutes. A large amount of the class is practice and reading on your own, but if you can handle that, your reward is an absurd amount of extra credit.

Lectures are too short for Organic Chemistry (15 minutes maximum). Required reading outside of class (openstax). Both lectures and Openstax don't relate to worksheets. Nothing relates to exams (were written the day before exam day). Professor doesn't understand O-Chem well (gets corrected and misses his own questions alot). DO NOT RECOMMEND. AVOID.
